update.title: 🚀 **Cozy Bot v1.0.6 - Major Update!** 🚀
update.description: We've upgraded CozyBot with amazing new features and improvements that will make your cozy experience even better!
features: 🆕 **New Commands:** `/profile`, `/top-users`, `/achievements`, `/stop` - Discover your cozy stats and control your experience!
🏆 **Gamification System** - Earn points for listening time (1 point/minute), unlock achievements, level up, and build daily streaks! Track your favorite sounds and compete on the leaderboard.
🔧 **Fixed Audio Interruptions** - Resolved the bug where sounds would stop unexpectedly - now plays continuously!
update.call_to_action: Experience the enhanced cozy vibes with `/rain`, `/sea`, `/sparkles`, or `/music`!
update.footer:
We wish you a great day! ✨
— Imène and Raphaël, CozyBot developers
